data.long_meaning: Derived from Witold, meaning 'defender of the people'. The feminine form, Wiktorina, evokes the strength and protection of God. The name Wiktorina carries the meaning “God's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Wiktorina usually hope their child will grow to embody god's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
